source: Source: Except Poverty data all other data are from Population and Housing Census of Maldives , 2006. Poverty Data are from Vulnerability and Povert Assesement Survey ( VPAII), 2004
notes: * Atoll Capital 1_ As of May 2003 NA: Data not available or not applicable
1 Population relocated to other islands under population consolidation programme
2 Newly inhabited under population consolidation programme
3 Population displaced to other islands due to tsunami
Sh. Maakandoodhoo population now residing in Milandhoo
GDh. Faresmaathoda population icludes Fares & Maathoda
Density: Population per squrae kilometer of land area
Reasons for Migration: Includes only the three main reasons for migration
Literacy Rate: (Number of persons who can simply read and write / Total population aged 6 years and above) * 100
Lower Secondary Competion Rate: Number of children who completed garde 10 and were 17 years by total population of those 17 years of age
Higher Secondary Competion Rate: Number of children who completed garde 12 and were 19 years by total population of those 19 years of age
Labouforce participation Rate: The number of economically active persons as a percentage of the population of 15 years of age and above
Unemployment Rate: The number of unemployed persons expressed as a percenatge of the economically active population
Household size: population / Number of households
Improved Sanitation Facilities: Either drainage to sea or use septic tank

Safe drinking water: The persentage of people with access to safe drinking water is high when rain water is included. But international standard considers untreated rain water as unsafe water mainly due to the way its been collected
Improved Sanitation Facilities: Either using garbage compounds or using waste disposal mechine
